qualification.details: Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: a. Scholars who are selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. b. The selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. Experience: Two years of research experience.

selection_process: Selection process through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. Selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Kharagpur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIT Kharagpur is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course selected through national eligibility tests like CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, along with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position is 32 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of up to Rs. 42,000 per month, which may vary based on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIT Kharagpur SRF position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official IIT Kharagpur website by filling out the application form and submitting it before the deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on performance in national eligibility tests like CSIR-UGC NET, GATE, or other national-level examinations conducted by central government departments and their agencies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a project-based position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.answer: The direct download link for the official notification PDF is provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
